text: Ewe's milk curd seeded with Penicillium roqueforti is drained without pressing and pierced, so the air in the fleurine-ventilated Combalou caves lets the mould vein the open paste. After at least two weeks bare in the caves the cheese is wrapped to slow the mould while it keeps maturing to at least 90 days.

steps.note: The curd is put into moulds without pressing; each cheese is 19–20 cm across and 2.5–3 kg.
The cheese is ripened unwrapped in the Combalou caves for at least two weeks, then wrapped, which slows the mould.
